name: BigEarthNet
description: BigEarthNet is a large-scale Sentinel-2 satellite image archive for multi-label land-cover classification, with image patches annotated using CORINE Land Cover classes. Imagery not vendored.
citation: Sumbul et al., BigEarthNet: A Large-Scale Benchmark Archive for Remote Sensing Image Understanding, IGARSS 2019.

license.notes: The BigEarthNet website identifies the dataset license as Community Data License Agreement – Permissive, Version 1.0. Imagery not vendored.
